prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity visual-direction comp for a desktop web application
Primary request: Design a 1440px expert desktop interface for PPTExtract, a human page-curation workbench. This is a real product UI screen, not a marketing page and not a photograph.
Scene/backdrop: A bright office drafting surface translated into a precise web application. The interface is one continuous “cartographic redline desk,” not a collection of floating cards.
Subject: The curator reviews one sanitized Chinese presentation page. Left 62%: a large standard page rendering with a Chinese title, an abstract analytical chart, a compact table, and three clearly numbered visual-object boundary boxes with crop handles. Right 34%: a synchronized legend-like editor showing 页面总述, 视觉对象 01/02/03, 纳入/排除 decisions, 排除原因, summary fields, a visible 未确认草稿 tag, and 审核状态 pending. Top: a narrow document/status rail with page 18/43, changed-page cue, progress, and explicit 批准 / 排除 actions. Bottom: a compact keyboard command strip with ←/→ 下一页, A 批准, X 排除, R 重新打开. Include a thin vertical document-depth axis and direct page-number jump. Make source evidence, current edit, inherited-prefill provenance, and blocking validation distinguishable.
Style/medium: High-fidelity desktop Web UI mockup. Cartographic drafting and redline correction translated functionally into interface grammar: translucent tracing-film overlay only over the page canvas, numbered survey boundaries, small legend keys, registered crop marks, precise scale ticks, tabular metrics. Dense, calm, expert, and immediately operable.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 screen, straight-on orthographic UI capture, full application visible edge to edge. Large page evidence remains the focal moment; inspector is dense but quieter. No marketing header, no device frame, no surrounding room.
Lighting/mood: Neutral daylight workbench, low glare, suitable for hours of editing.
Color palette: drafting vellum #F3F0E7, ink #1C2A33, survey teal #167C80, vermilion redline #D94A38, restrained safety yellow #E4B849.
Materials/textures: Very subtle drafting linen, translucent tracing film, graphite rules, vermilion redline marks. Materials must not reduce text readability.
Text (verbatim where legible): "PPTExtract", "第 18 / 43 页", "页面总述", "视觉对象 01", "视觉对象 02", "视觉对象 03", "纳入", "排除", "排除原因", "未确认草稿", "待审核", "批准", "重新打开", "A 批准", "X 排除", "← → 翻页".
Constraints: Use only sanitized synthetic content; no real filenames, medical topics, people, personal data, logos, or claims. Core controls must look implementable in semantic HTML/CSS. State cannot rely on color alone. Avoid excessive rounded cards; use one continuous work surface with disciplined regions.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, glow, neon, bento card grid, oversized typography, marketing hero, photographic room scene, people, laptop/device mockup, illegible tiny clutter, generic SaaS dashboard, rasterized decorative icons, English-only interface.
